rationale: Crimean Bridge attack continues as major strategic development; Trump-Putin-Xi summit is new but rhetoric-only at this stage; other events remain background or distant.

top_events.title: Putin's Crimean Bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine
top_events.label: Ukraine strikes Crimean Bridge in major attack
top_events.summary: Ukrainian missile and drone attack partially destroys the strategic Crimean Bridge, a key supply route for Russian forces. The operation took weeks to plan and represents a significant escalation in Ukraine's long-range strike capability.

top_events.title: Trump shakes hands with Putin and Xi ahead of historic talks in China
top_events.label: Trump Putin Xi meet for first trilateral summit
top_events.summary: The three leaders meet together for the first time in a closely-watched summit. No concrete outcomes yet; the meeting itself is a significant diplomatic development but impact on Poland depends on future agreements.

top_events.title: Five EU states announce plans for immigration 'return hubs' in Rwanda
top_events.label: Five EU states plan Rwanda deportation hubs
top_events.summary: Germany, Austria, Netherlands, Denmark, and Greece announce joint offshore immigration return centers in Rwanda. The policy faces legal and moral challenges but signals a major shift in EU migration approach.

short_summary: Ukraine destroys part of Crimea bridge

most_significant_event.label: Ukraine destroys part of Crimea bridge
most_significant_event.summary: Ukraine's weeks-planned strike partially collapses Putin's strategic Crimea bridge, marking unprecedented escalation in the war on Poland's eastern border. Kremlin vows reconstruction.
most_significant_event.title: Putin's Crimea bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine
